speaker: alice
text: Right, time for some brilliant conservation news. New Zealand's kakapo, one of the world's rarest birds with just 235 adults, has just smashed its breeding records.

speaker: charlie
text: These chunky flightless parrots hatched over 100 chicks this year, beating their previous best of 85 from 2019. The vets were so dedicated they even performed CPR on struggling chicks.

speaker: alice
text: And globally, the High Seas Treaty officially kicked in this year, creating legal protection for nearly two-thirds of the world's oceans. It's the biggest ocean conservation milestone in decades.
